items.title: Tee Higgins: Second 100-yard effort of season in win
items.text:
Higgins secured six of seven targets for 148 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Downs: Held to two grabs in Sunday's loss
items.text:
Downs caught two of four targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Vikings.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Marvin Harrison: Gets first TD with Texans
items.text:
Harrison caught one of four targets for a six-yard touchdown in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: C.J. Stroud: Two TD passes in OT loss
items.text:
Stroud completed 17 of 28 passes for 153 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants. He added two rushing attempts for four yards and threw a successful two-point conversion.

items.title: Woody Marks: Racks up 20 touches in Week 7
items.text:
Marks rushed 19 times for 66 yards and caught his only target for 15 yards in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.
